name: Bomb Arena
hook: Drop bombs, break crates, be the last one standing.
how: Drop bombs to blast crates open and catch rivals in the cross-shaped flames; a blast sets off any bomb it reaches. Crates hide power-ups: more bombs, longer blasts, speed and kicking bombs. When the timer runs out the walls close in. First to 3 round wins takes the match.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move, Space to drop a bomb; on touch, the D-pad and the bomb button
uses: The host's browser times every bomb, resolves the blasts and decides who got caught; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the arena up to four players. They bomb crates and rivals, grab power-ups, kick bombs and run from blasts.
Rounds won, all time, shown at the end of each match.
Every bomb goes off on every screen at the same moment.
ideas: Add a power-up that lets you throw bombs over walls
Make the arena an ice rink where players slide until they hit something
Add two teleport pads in opposite corners
